Rumors suggest Apple will use "iPhone Ultra" as the branding for its upcoming foldable model, with Mark Gurman indicating this is indeed the name widely used internally within the company.

"iPhone Ultra" foldable phone name reportedly in use internally at Apple

Apple is set to unveil the highly anticipated foldable iPhone at its September event next month.

Since rumors of the first foldable iPhone began circulating, the device has generally been referred to as the "iPhone Fold".

However, earlier this year, leakers began claiming that "iPhone Ultra" would be the name of the product.

While we can't say this confirms Apple's plans, well-connected tipster Mark Gurman posted on X today: "Everyone internally calls it the Ultra."

"Ultra" is a name commonly used by many Apple employees, but this doesn't mean it's the final branding.

Apple is known for its secrecy, so many employees typically don't know about unannounced products unless they're directly involved in the relevant work.

The internal use of "iPhone Ultra" may simply be because the outside world has been calling this foldable device Ultra. In fact, perhaps only core members of Apple's marketing team and other informed employees know the actual branding plans for the product.

What do you think—will iPhone Ultra become the name for the foldable? What other names might have a better chance? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
